title.en: EVE Academy – Starting an Epic Arc

blocks.en: Epic Arcs are chains of missions
blocks.zh: 史诗任务线（Epic Arc）是一连串任务，

blocks.en: through which you follow a unique storyline.
blocks.zh: 你会在其中体验一段独特的剧情。

blocks.en: Completing an epic arc gives special rewards,
blocks.zh: 完成史诗任务线可获得特殊奖励，

blocks.en: which are much more valuable than other missions of a similar level.
blocks.zh: 远比同等级的其他任务更有价值。

blocks.en: To find an Epic Arc, open the Agency window,
blocks.zh: 要寻找史诗任务线，打开代理机构窗口，

blocks.en: and click on the "Agents and Missions" tab at the top.
blocks.zh: 点击顶部的「代理人与任务」标签页，

blocks.en: Then click on "Epic Arcs".
blocks.zh: 再点击「史诗任务线（Epic Arcs）」。

blocks.en: Here you can see a list of available Epic Arcs.
blocks.zh: 这里会列出可接取的史诗任务线。

blocks.en: Note that most Epic Arcs require you to have a minimum standing
blocks.zh: 注意，大多数史诗任务线要求你

blocks.en: with a faction or corporation.
blocks.zh: 在某个势力或军团中达到最低声望。

blocks.en: However the Sisters of EVE Epic Arc,
blocks.zh: 不过姐妹会的史诗任务线

blocks.en: "The Blood-Stained Stars", has no minimum requirement,
blocks.zh: 「血染群星（The Blood-Stained Stars）」没有最低要求，

blocks.en: and is relatively easy and rewarding to complete as a new player.
blocks.zh: 对新玩家来说相对简单，奖励也不错。

blocks.en: To begin an Epic Arc simply select the one you are interested in
blocks.zh: 要开始史诗任务线，只需选中你感兴趣的那条，

blocks.en: and hit the "Set Destination" button to head out to meet your agent.
blocks.zh: 点击「设为目的地」按钮，出发去见代理人。

blocks.en: Once you arrive at your agent's station,
blocks.zh: 到达代理人所在的空间站后，

blocks.en: open the Epic Arc screen in the Agency window,
blocks.zh: 在代理机构窗口中打开史诗任务线界面，

blocks.en: and click "Start Conversation" to receive your first mission.
blocks.zh: 点击「开始对话（Start Conversation）」领取第一个任务。

blocks.en: Review the mission details and click Accept to begin.
blocks.zh: 查看任务详情后点击「接受」开始。

blocks.en: Then follow the Agent Mission details
blocks.zh: 然后按照屏幕左侧的

blocks.en: on the left side of your screen to complete your objectives.
blocks.zh: 代理人任务详情完成各项目标。

blocks.en: When you arrive in a system where you have an objective to complete,
blocks.zh: 到达有目标需要完成的星系后，

blocks.en: you can easily warp into the mission
blocks.zh: 可以在太空中通过右键菜单

blocks.en: by using the right-click context menu in space.
blocks.zh: 轻松跃迁进任务地点。

blocks.en: As you complete each mission, the next mission in the arc will be offered.
blocks.zh: 每完成一个任务，就会收到任务线中的下一个任务。

blocks.en: You can track your progress via the Epic Arc window in the Agency.
blocks.zh: 你可以在代理机构的史诗任务线窗口中追踪进度。

blocks.en: If you're ever not sure what the next step is,
blocks.zh: 如果不确定下一步该做什么，

blocks.en: you can always find it again here.
blocks.zh: 随时可以在这里重新找到。

blocks.en: Keep completing these missions until you've seen the story through to its end.
blocks.zh: 不断完成这些任务，直到看完整段剧情。

blocks.en: Then bask in your accomplishment and its rewards.
blocks.zh: 然后尽情享受你的成就和奖励吧。
